description.value: Lupins Café is one of several dining venues at the summit of Grouse Mountain, a major year-round outdoor recreation destination above North Vancouver. The mountain is home to the Grouse Bike Park, making the café a natural post-ride stop for mountain bikers who have taken the Skyride up. The site is also reachable on foot via the iconic Grouse Grind trail, a popular challenge for active visitors.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Lupins Café is a real, active dining venue at Grouse Mountain, listed under 'Dining & Food' alongside several other eateries. However, the fetched content is almost entirely navigation/boilerplate — no café-specific page content about menu, amenities, or facilities was captured, so nearly all amenity fields remain null. A notable access concern: Lupins Café sits at the Grouse Mountain summit, reachable only via the paid Skyride gondola or on foot via the Grouse Grind/BCMC trail — road cyclists cannot ride to it directly, though the site's Bike Park (opening June 5th) indicates mountain bikers are a target audience.
concerns: Lupins Café is located at the Grouse Mountain summit and is accessible only via the paid Skyride gondola or on foot (Grouse Grind/BCMC trail) — road cyclists cannot cycle to it directly. This access limitation should be surfaced in the directory listing.
The /lupins subpage did not render unique café-specific content; all fetched pages returned the same site-wide navigation boilerplate, leaving menu and amenity details unverifiable.
No address or phone number is present in OSM or on the website for this specific venue.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating café at an active mountain resort with a Bike Park; directly relevant to mountain bikers and active visitors reaching the summit.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Grouse Bike Park is listed as opening June 5th; mountain bikers using the park are the most likely cycling-tourist audience for this café.
